DML.SELECT: SELECT management_area_id as "id", user_id as "userId", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.management_area_users WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.management_area_users (management_area_id, user_id, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:id, :userId, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM conf.management_area_users WHERE management_area_id = :id AND user_id = :userId
